_comment: VIDEO generation (TikTok, adverts). This is a MOTION brief, not
a face description: the face comes from the still render, which
is why still.json is generated first. Re-describing the face in
text is exactly how identity drifts between clips.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

reference_image.source: appearance/still.json -> the approved headshot or classroom render for this tutor
reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Do not go the other way and pull a still out of a clip - video frames are soft, motion-blurred and compressed.

_identity_lock_note: if the model supports text guidance alongside the reference, restate ONLY these - they are what the audience recognises

performance.energy: relaxed and generous, unhurried - lowers the room's anxiety
performance.spoken_register: warm conversational, unhurried, repeats for emphasis
performance.body: leans in toward the student, forearms on the desk or one hand on the board rail; talks with open palms
performance.expression: broad encouraging grin, eyebrows raised in invitation; the face of someone who has never made a learner feel stupid

camera.framing: 9:16 vertical for TikTok - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, same accessories and same hairstyle across a campaign; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this tutor's own scripts (greetings/, signoffs/, samples.json)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a tutor

shots.purpose: TikTok / advert hook, talking to camera
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. A 40-46 year old Coloured South African (Cape) male teacher, big-framed and heavyset, broad shoulders, thick forearms, comfortable in his size, round full face, wide smile with a slight gap in the upper teeth, laugh lines fanning from bright hazel-brown eyes, medium-tan skin with warm golden undertone, faint stubble shadow. Hair: shaved close to the scalp, neat hairline; short moustache. Wearing short-sleeve checked shirt (blue and white, or maroon) worn open over a plain t-shirt, dark chinos, comfortable leather shoes. Energy: relaxed and generous, unhurried - lowers the room's anxiety. Delivery matches the voice: warm conversational, unhurried, repeats for emphasis. stands relaxed and open, weight on one leg, palms turned slightly outward as if mid-explanation. Background: the same plain seamless studio backdrop as the reference still, bare and evenly lit. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural micro-movement, photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

shots.purpose: background b-roll, not looking at camera
shots.prompt: The person from the reference image in the same studio, leans in toward the student, forearms on the desk or one hand on the board rail; talks with open palms Not looking at camera, listening then glancing to lens. Natural light quality, static camera or slow push-in, 8 seconds.

negative_prompt: face drifting from the reference image, changing age, changing skin tone, changing hairline, morphing wardrobe, warping hands, extra fingers, jittering eyes, lip-sync mismatch, whip pans, orbiting camera, speed ramps, slow motion, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
